scope_note: Covers the statutory basis for appointing the person who chairs Food Standards Scotland: who makes the appointment, the eligibility and disqualification conditions, the terms and duration of office, how the office ends, and the public-appointments regime governing the appointment process. Confined to legislation (Acts and SIs); non-statutory codes and guidance made under those Acts are identified but their content is out of scope in this mode.

steps.title: Identify the Act establishing Food Standards Scotland and its membership provisions
steps.detail: Identify the primary Scottish legislation establishing Food Standards Scotland and set out the provision governing the number and appointment of its members, distinguishing the chairing member from the other members.

steps.title: Establish who appoints the chair and on what terms
steps.detail: Establish which body or office-holder makes the appointment of the chair, whether any approval or confirmation by another body is required on the face of the Act, and the provisions governing the period, terms and conditions of membership, remuneration, resignation and re-appointment.

steps.title: Establish the eligibility conditions and disqualifications
steps.detail: Find the provisions disqualifying persons from appointment as a member, any duty on the appointing body as to the manner in which appointments are made, and the provisions under which membership ends early or may be ended.

steps.title: Identify whether the appointment is a regulated public appointment
steps.detail: Establish whether Food Standards Scotland is listed under the Scottish public-appointments legislation such that the appointment of its chair is regulated, and identify the provision that puts it there.

steps.title: Set out the public-appointments regime that governs the process
steps.detail: Find the provisions establishing the code of practice governing the making of appointments to specified authorities, who prepares it, what it must or may cover, and what powers exist where the code is not complied with.
